rationale: The discourse has converged on the process and on the need for quantified, site-by-site analysis, but the core dispute remains unresolved: labor/state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management/owners/investors still require permanent structural savings and keep closures available. The last two rounds show only clarified positions and expert nuance, not substantive movement toward agreement, so a facilitator-led intervention is needed to break the impasse.
